sharedContext: Ben explicitly ordered this BVPGM and a live push on 2026-08-31.
The working tree is very dirty and unrelated work must remain excluded. No stage-all operation is allowed.

Current local homepage already uses HeroStatic, HomeValueFold, LanesDocumentarySection, value output, How It Works, Proof boundary, and operations cards; Maria copy remains in lib/copy.ts and old narrative modules/routes may still expose it.

Existing object and human-space assets include the tool at rest, van at dawn, workshop pegboard, materials staged, reception quiet, workshop interior, proof imagery, kitchens, desks, and documentary lane stills.
People, Bellows, and Proof already share violet/copper tokens and route classes, but the experience still risks visual sameness across long text-and-bubble pages.
No new image spend, provider work, schema, secret, production-data mutation, or live verification claim belongs in this slice.
Lady Jessica remains the sole push/deploy seat after Ben, Heimerdinker, and Lady Jessica sign the exact candidate.
